_comment: Streaming-soak pins PER NUMERIC FINGERPRINT (tests/streaming_soak_test.cpp; 2026-09-22). A failed-tick count on a
seeded 400-tick walk over a VALUE-DEPENDENT rung (MonotoneCubic: the state sits on Hyman branch boundaries, where an
ulp decides the branch) is deterministic for one instruction stream and different for another -- the same seeded
walk read 0 failed ticks on mixed_scheme under Apple clang and 2 under GCC/glibc. So, exactly like the perf
baselines (baselines.json), these rows are keyed by the numeric fingerprint OS|compiler|arch flags|ISA (the CPU
model is NOT in the key: the same instruction stream gives the same doubles on any chip). A row with no entry for
the running key is REPORT-ONLY; the test prints the measured values to paste. Pins only ever RATCHET DOWN per key.
Universal invariants stay hard-coded in the test (every linear rung, and every rung on the smoothed factor walk,
at ZERO failed ticks with the class dq tolerance): those are platform-independent by construction.
Rows: smoothed_per_row = the API Light preset on the PER-ROW stress walk; unsmoothed_factor = no regulariser on the
factor walk. failed = the pin per 400 ticks (scaled to SWAPS_SOAK_TICKS); dq = the quote-space tolerance (rate) of
the delivered curve vs a cold solve of the same objective (a value-dependent rung compares two LM optima on a
kinked landscape, so it is a class tolerance ~1.5x the measurement, not a rounding bound).

2026-10-13 (K48, smoothing is a tie-breaker, never a trade against the quotes): the SMOOTHED recipe is now min-curvature within +-1 bp BOUNDS (bound row + a weak mid row per quote; tests/streaming_soak_test.cpp soak()), and the value-dependent rungs are pinned per fingerprint on the smoothed FACTOR walk too -- the old recipe (the Light preset at 0.5 on hard quotes) kept a MonotoneCubic long end off its Hyman branch boundaries by bending the quotes 0.1..0.7 bp, which is what the rule forbids. These rows RESTART from the measured values under the new recipe (desk_mixed smoothed_factor 87 / smoothed_per_row 9, mixed_scheme 0 / 63, mixed_convex 0 / 0, with ~1.5x dq slack) and ratchet down from here.

Darwin|AppleClang 21.0.0.21000101|-march.note: the reference machine (Mac Pro 2019, Xeon W-3223; perf fingerprint 966685f93279), seed 20260921. mixed_convex (2026-10-12): the mixed rung with its long end on MonotoneConvex (AAD block, ~110..150 us/tick) read 0 failed ticks on every walk, even the unsmoothed factor walk where MonotoneCubic's Hyman branches fail 49 -- no branch kinks to park on; dq pinned ~1.5x the measurement. RE-PINNED 2026-11-01 (mixed_scheme smoothed_per_row 63 -> 66, desk_mixed 9 -> 10): NormalOp::form() became the thin pseudo-inverse (T^-1 Q1^T, not Eigen's solve against a full identity), which differs from the full solve at the ulp (6e-16 relative on every desk, the same ||MJ-I||) -- on a Hyman-filtered rung that ulp re-routes the seeded walk exactly as a toolchain change does (the full solve on the same code read 58 / 2). An operator rounding change is a fingerprint change for these rows, not a regression. RE-PINNED AGAIN the same day (desk_mixed smoothed_factor 87 -> 106, smoothed_per_row 10 -> 24): the desk rungs gained the EUR 6M fixing as the 6M curve's front anchor (PRINCIPLES P15, a row and a knot), so desk_mixed is a different seeded walk; its linear twin `desk` streams every walk at 0 failed ticks as before, which is what says the anchor is right and the Hyman long end is what fails. RE-PINNED 2026-11-02 (owner's rule: every overnight curve carries its 1D fixing beside its futures strip, and the ladder's generating state is a straight line in time -- the index-linear state put the Hyman long end on a kink under the 25 bp gate tick once the 1D knot was in): desk_mixed smoothed_factor 106 -> 10, smoothed_per_row 24 -> 23, unsmoothed_factor 108 -> 1; mixed_scheme unsmoothed_factor 62 -> 10, smoothed_per_row 66 -> 68 (measured 68), smoothed_factor dq 2e-12 -> 4e-12 (measured 2.6e-12). The fixings themselves stay HARD in the smoothed recipe (a published fixing has no bid/offer); a new seeded walk, the linear rungs at 0 failed ticks on every walk as before
